title: By Their Unsullied Blood
subtitle: When, with blood, the disordered threads are soothed, fate shall reclaim what was once eschewed.

trails.title: Black and White
trails.description: We all seek the answer, but we move from opposite sides.

content.text: Congratulations, you cleared the stage. Though I hardly thought it'd take you so long.
The answer was right in front of you the whole time; just cover your eyes. Funny—you had to do the very thing the enemy wanted you to.
That was your third lesson: Hands serve to control.
As for the first and the second, well, you've already seen the digestive and excretory systems. Save us both the time and look over your logs if you're curious.
Back to the topic. You almost died in there thanks to the false intel from your eye scouts.
Luckily, brain command reacted quickly enough to prevent the worst from happening.
You'd better set a second-in-command to avoid this kind of thing happening again.

branch.text: Hmm. The ever-beating strategic center, the hub that every drop of blood must pass through, the violently beating when agitated.
The most reliable organ, besides the brain. Because it has to be.
If only it didn't have a mind of its own. That'll surely lead to destruction, whether it beats fast or slow.
The pass—the gate to the body, allowing thoughts to spill out and nutrition to enter.
And the minister of foreign affairs.
But don't let it take too much charge. Otherwise, disputes and disease will fester in it.
It wasn't my intention to talk like a Renaissance artist.
But when you reflect on Michelangelo's painting on that grand ceiling, there's no choice but to do so.
The key to creating life could be either the hall of wisdom or the land of birth ...
So, you should understand art a little better now.

content.text: I believe my mouth can do it.

items.text: By Their Unsullied Blood
Lava Tube, Sanctuary
Words fall alongside the arcane skill's radiance. Sonetto and the Preacher's pupils each reflect the other's form.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: It seems you've already made up your mind.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I have. My duty is clear, and I'll honor it no matter what.
After a brief silence, another violent tremor rocks the sanctuary.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper!

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: So, this is how it ends.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ends? What are you talking about?
The Preacher doesn't respond. Setting down the idol, she walks toward her.
Sonetto tenses, but the Preacher merely brushes past.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: Remember your words today, Ms. Sonetto.
The Preacher leaves. Sonetto steps forward, then freezes at a glint from the shadows.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This is ...
Altar, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Hmph. You've proven yourselves to be quite resistant to death. I should've known you'd have yet another shared quality with a cockroach.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: No matter. You have blasphemed in the face of the Great Mother. There is naught for you but damnation now.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Vertin, watch out!
Nautika swings her tail, scattering Animus's intense arcane energy.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Wh-What do we do now?
The flesh pulsates again, swelling more, now swollen to its limit.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sorry, Nautika. I'm afraid we'll have to postpone your plans to head home.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We have to stop the ritual before Arcana is fully revived.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Arcana? Is that what those Snow Monsters were trying to do? Bring someone back from the dead?
Nautika stamps her talons into the ground, bracing for a counterattack, or more accurately, vengeance.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nautika, at one o'clock!

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Oh. Okay!
She swings her bone-whip toward the flesh, but before impact, a rising surge of black mucus walls off each side.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Strike from above!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Hmph! Child's play.
The black liquid weaves a filament-thin net, straining to trap the soaring prey. Still fumbling with her unfamiliar flesh, Nautika loses balance.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Ah! My tail! I-I can't fly!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I   know   the   moon,   and   this   is   an   alien   city.
A transparent shield forms in the air, blocking off the sizzling liquid.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper! You're alright! And ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Is that Ms. Amundsen?

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Another one? Filthy little wretch. How did you slip past the mist?
She trails off upon seeing the little bottle clutched in Sonetto's hand.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Ragh! That damnable "Preacher"!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: How utterly feckless must one be to be bested by a child?

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: That worthless, shameless, thankless imbecile! She was always unworthy of her role!

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Sonetto, take my hand.
She dives, splitting the air into a shriek. As her massive, hard tail knocks aside attacks, Sonetto seizes her chance, jumping up to grab Nautika's talons.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Get up here.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Urgh!
The once separated companions now meet again in midair, hands clasped tight.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Haha! The team's back together again. And we can stop them together.
Altar, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: You have well and truly reached the boundaries of my patience.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: To think that you believe you can alter the path designated by the great Mother of Resurrection! Hah!
Though forced back, Animus raises her longbow and lets out an ominous laugh.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Utter futility! The final reckoning has come!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: And when you lay your eyes upon THEM, I shall delight in the melody of your screams!
Animus is the first to kneel before the throbbing, swollen flesh. At her lead, every believer drops to the ground.
The mucus surges around them, forming a protective barrier for the ritual.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: What are they—Wait! Are they offering themselves as the final sacrifice?

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Their eyes see not one light of Bright Star.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Men's past ways are shaded by their shame.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Paeans are but flattery's mirror half.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: When blood soothes frantic threads ...
The robes shrivel until only empty fabric remains, carried away by the formless liquid.
The once-red blood darkens, becoming veins, pulsing with the rhythmic throbbing of the black heart at their center.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: These fluctuations are powerful. This is bad.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: At last, the moment has come!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: The Sufferer is returned! For through flesh and blood a vessel is forged, and so SHE walks among us once more!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: SHE shall right the wrongs of this world and lead us to our former glory!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: SHE shall restore the promised land! Let the great "Flood" wash away all falsehood!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Let the ages begin anew! Return us to the Blank Era, where arcanists reign as masters of all!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Return us to paradise! Restore the true utopia!
TO BE CONTINUED…
